summary: Master the essentials of Metadata Management and Information Classification. Join our training to boost your data management expertise today.
lede: Metadata management and information classification help teams organize, label, and handle business information consistently. Designed for records and information staff, document controllers, governance teams, and others responsible for business records, the course addresses the practical task of making information easier to find and safer to share. Participants learn to define usable metadata fields and naming rules, build classification levels and handling guidance, and connect labels with access, retention, search, and reporting practices.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals across various sectors who deal with information management.
audience: Compliance, risk, and internal audit staff
Data governance, knowledge management, and content managers
HR, finance, legal, and procurement officers
modules: Foundations of Metadata and Information Classification
Designing Metadata That People Will Actually Use
Naming Conventions and Folder Structures That Scale
Building a Practical Information Classification Framework
Linking Classification to Access Control and Security
Metadata for Search, Reporting, and Decision Support
Handling Exceptions, Edge Cases, and High-Risk Scenarios
Capstone: Build Your Organization’s Metadata and Classification Blueprint
prerequisites: No prior experience with metadata management or information classification is required, but familiarity with organizational document practices is beneficial. Participants should have access to a computer with internet connectivity to participate in online exercises and group work.
